REFERENCE2 provides ONLY the four physical poses A,B,C,D. Use the thick red/blue legs and arms to see the DIFFERENCE. Red is NEAR side and blue FAR side; render normal skin and unchanged white clothing, NO diagram colors or symbols.
A (upper-left): NEAR leg is extended forward to SCREEN LEFT supporting; FAR leg is folded behind to SCREEN RIGHT. NEAR arm and hand are BACK near the right/back hip, FAR arm and hand ahead at SCREEN LEFT.

NEAR arm and hand now FORWARD at SCREEN LEFT overlapping the FRONT of the bodice, FAR arm and hand BACK. C must NOT be the same near-leg-forward/near-arm-back pose as A.
D (lower-right): REVERSE B. FAR supporting leg pushes BACK toward SCREEN RIGHT; NEAR knee lifts high forward toward SCREEN LEFT, near foot ahead of hips. Near arm returns back while far arm moves forward.
Follow exactly the four different limb poses in the guide, maintaining near/far occlusion correctly. All figures face LEFT, no front-facing or right-facing substitution. No extra limbs, no long thighs, no twisted knees; complete natural bodies and sleeves. Keep margins above horns, below shoes and beside wings/tails. No numbers, labels, grid, floor or shadows. This is a keypose study to verify actual alternating legs and opposite arm swing before making all24 inbetweens.
